textual.observation: The speaker links a claimed good return for existing and new members to daily instructions to promote and use the coin.

evidence.quote: some of us made quite a good return on their investment
our new members want to make a very good return
Excite people about the coin.
Use the coin.

textual.context: Promotional event speech; the return language is framed as an assumption or expectation, not an explicit guarantee.
textual.potential_relevance: The source pairs an investment-return claim with audience-directed promotion and product-use actions, so later context assessment may need to distinguish a promotional offer from general event commentary.
textual.limitations: Actual returns, guarantee status, fees, eligibility, and whether promotion or use is required are not established.

textual.observation: The speaker describes a physical-item claim tied to accumulating 15 grams of gold in an account after account gold is converted into gold coins.

evidence.quote: this milligrams of gold will be converted into five or gold coins
whenever you have 15 grams of gold in this account you can claim a physical point of Jewish

textual.limitations: The ASR wording for the coin quantity and physical item is unclear; funding, valuation, delivery, and redemption terms are not established.

textual.observation: The speaker says an account investment can be converted to cash at any time and can also be used to buy more coins, while describing availability as 24/7 with no limitations.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because a speaker at a branded OneCoin event links participation by existing and new members to investment-return language and directs attendees to promote and use the coin. The presentation claims that an investment can be converted to cash at any time and describes account-based gold redemption, exchange, commissions, KYC, and account features. It also acknowledges that transactions occurred only on the internal exchange, while actual returns, funding, redemption, commission terms, and successful cash conversion are not established.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker links reported coin-investment returns and desired returns for new members to a presentation that offers further coin purchases. The reported past returns are not proof of actual returns or a guaranteed future return.

evidence.observation: The speaker reports returns for some existing participants and expresses an expectation about returns sought by new members.

evidence.observation: The speaker says coin transactions are currently limited to the internal exchange.
